blocks.text: Yeh chapter 28 (Chromatography) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is chromatography? Why is it needed instead of filtration or distillation for some mixtures?
(Chromatography kya hai? Kuch mixtures ke liye filtration ya distillation ki bajaye is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatography aik analytical technique hai jo complex mixture ke components ko do mukhtalif phases ke liye un ki mukhtalif affinity (kashish) ki buniyad par alag karti hai. Simple mixture filtration, distillation ya solvent extraction se alag ho jata hai, lekin complex mixture ke liye chromatography jaisi advanced technique chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Chromatography is a versatile and important analytical technique

blocks.prompt:
2 Give three examples of complex mixtures separated by chromatography and name three fields in which it is used.
(Chromatography se alag hone wale teen complex mixtures ki misaalein aur teen shobe batayein jahan yeh istemal hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Mixtures: phoolon ke dyes, paani mein pollutants (aaloodgi), patton se dawai ke extracts. Shobe: medicine, forensic science aur environmental science, jahan yeh substances ki pehchan, safai aur miqdaar bohat durustgi se maloom karti hai.

book_ref.quote: making chromatography an efficient modern chemical analytical tool in medicine, forensic, environmental science

blocks.prompt:
3 Name the three important types of chromatography with their short forms.
(Chromatography ki teen ahem qismein un ke short naamon ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Paper chromatography (PC), (2) Thin layer chromatography (TLC), (3) Gas chromatography (GC).

book_ref.quote: Among many types of chromatography, the three important types are:

blocks.prompt:
4 Define paper chromatography and name its stationary and mobile phases.
(Paper chromatography ki tareef karein aur is ke stationary aur mobile phase batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Paper chromatography woh technique hai jis mein solvent ke zariye paper par mixture ko us ke components mein alag kiya jata hai. Stationary phase: paper ke cellulose ke saath juda paani. Mobile phase: solvent jo paper par upar chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The technique of using a solvent to separate a mixture into its components is called paper chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe how the sample is applied to the paper and how the paper is placed in the solvent.
(Batayein ke sample paper par kaise lagaya jata hai aur paper solvent mein kaise rakha jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Capillary tube se sample ka chhota spot paper ke neeche ke qareeb base line par lagaya jata hai. Paper ko munasib solvent mein dubaya jata hai jo paper mein upar charhta hai; solvent ki satah spot se neeche rakhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The solvent level must be below the spot of the sample.

blocks.prompt:
6 Why do some components of a sample stay near the baseline in paper chromatography?
(Paper chromatography mein sample ke kuch components baseline ke qareeb kyun reh jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh components solvent ki nisbat paper mein phanse paani (stationary phase) mein ziyada hal hote hain, is liye paper par ziyada upar nahi jate.

book_ref.quote: Others dissolve better in the water trapped in the paper (stationary phase); therefore, they do not travel very far up the paper.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a locating agent? Why is it needed?
(Locating agent kya hai? Is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Locating agent woh cheez hai jo chromatogram par spray ki jati hai aur be-rang substances ko rang de deti hai. Is ki zaroorat is liye hai ke be-rang spots warna nazar nahi aate.

book_ref.quote: Colourless substances can be visualised by spraying them with a locating agent which give colour to them.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define Rf value and write its formula.
(Rf value ki tareef karein aur is ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rf (retardation ya retention factor) substance ke tay kiye faasle ko solvent ke tay kiye faasle se taqseem karne se milti hai:
Rf = substance ka faasla / solvent ka faasla.

book_ref.quote: The Rf value (Retardation factor or Retention factor) of a substance

blocks.prompt:
9 Why has Rf no unit? Can an Rf value be greater than 1?
(Rf ka unit kyun nahi? Kya Rf value 1 se bari ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rf do faaslon (dono cm mein) ki ratio hai, is liye unit cancel ho jata hai. Yeh 1 se bari nahi ho sakti kyun ke substance solvent ke saath chalta hai aur solvent front se aage nahi ja sakta.

book_ref.quote: Rf has no unit because it is ratio.

blocks.prompt:
10 On a paper chromatogram the solvent moved 7.5 cm and a spot moved 3.0 cm from the baseline. Calculate the Rf value of the spot.
(Paper chromatogram par solvent 7.5 cm aur aik spot baseline se 3.0 cm chala. Spot ki Rf value nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Rf = spot ka faasla / solvent ka faasla = 3.0 cm / 7.5 cm = 0.40 (koi unit nahi).

book_ref.quote: is calculated by dividing the distance traveled by the component with the distance travelled by the solvent.

blocks.prompt:
11 A substance has Rf = 0.35 in a solvent. How far will its spot move when the solvent front moves 9.0 cm?
(Aik substance ki Rf = 0.35 hai. Jab solvent front 9.0 cm chale to is ka spot kitna chale ga?)
blocks.explanation: Substance ka faasla = Rf × solvent ka faasla = 0.35 × 9.0 cm = 3.15 cm (taqreeban 3.2 cm).

book_ref.quote: is calculated by dividing the distance traveled by the component with the distance travelled by the solvent.

blocks.prompt:
12 Under what conditions does the Rf value of a substance remain constant? How does this help?
(Kin halaat mein substance ki Rf value qaim rehti hai? Is ka kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Same solvent aur same temperature par Rf value nahi badalti. Is liye substance ki Rf value ko unhi halaat mein li gayi standard value se mila kar us ki pehchan ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The Rf value of a substance does not change under same conditions (same solvent and same temperature).

blocks.prompt:
13 How is a TLC plate prepared?
(TLC plate kaise tayyar ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ko paani mein mila kar slurry banayi jati hai aur glass slide par barabar phailayi jati hai. Phir oven mein sukha kar safed solid layer banti hai jo stationary phase hai.

book_ref.quote: This layer is dried in an oven to make a white solid layer (stationary phase) on the glass slide.

blocks.prompt:
14 Name the stationary and mobile phases in TLC.
(TLC mein stationary aur mobile phase ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase: glass slide par alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ki sookhi safed solid layer. Mobile phase: chromatography tank ka solvent, jo baseline se neeche rakha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The glass slide is dipped in the solvent (mobile phase) in such a way that baseline is above solvent level.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a solvent front? Why is it marked?
(Solvent front kya hai? Ise mark kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solvent front woh sab se ooncha nuqta hai jahan tak solvent pohancha. Slide nikalte hi ise mark karte hain kyun ke spots ki Rf value nikalne ke liye solvent ka faasla chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Solvent front, the highest point reached by the solvent, is marked.

blocks.prompt:
16 Give three ways of making colourless spots visible in TLC.
(TLC mein be-rang spots ko nazar aane wala banane ke teen tareeqe batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Ninhydrin spray, jo be-rang amino acids ko purple (jamni) kar deta hai. (2) Ultra-violet light, jis mein kuch be-rang substances chamakte hain. (3) Iodine vapours, jin se kuch substances bhoore ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Some colourless substances glow when irradiated with ultra-violet light

blocks.prompt:
17 Two spots on a TLC slide are at 1.8 cm and 4.2 cm from the baseline; the solvent front is at 6.0 cm. Calculate both Rf values and state which spot is more polar (polar stationary phase).
(TLC slide par do spots baseline se 1.8 cm aur 4.2 cm par hain; solvent front 6.0 cm par hai. Dono ki Rf nikalein aur batayein kaun sa spot ziyada polar hai (polar stationary phase).)
blocks.explanation: Rf₁ = 1.8/6.0 = 0.30; Rf₂ = 4.2/6.0 = 0.70. Rf 0.30 wala spot ziyada polar hai: polar substances polar stationary phase par ziyada mazbooti se adsorb ho kar ahista chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: TLC is faster than paper chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
18 How can TLC check the purity of a substance and the progress of a reaction?
(TLC se substance ki purity aur reaction ki progress kaise check hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Purity: substance ka spot laga kar us ke spots standard Rf values se milaye jate hain; ziyada spots doosre substances ki maujoodgi dikhate hain. Reaction progress: TLC dikhati hai ke reactants khatam ho rahe hain aur products ban rahe hain.

book_ref.quote: The purity of a substance can be checked by TLC.

blocks.prompt:
19 Give two uses of TLC in environmental and forensic work.
(Environmental aur forensic kaam mein TLC ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Environmental: mitti, paani, khanay aur hawa mein pollutants, pesticides aur zehreele substances ka pata. Forensic: jurm ki jagah par drugs, dhamakay ka malba, khoon, paseena aur semen ki pehchan.

book_ref.quote: can also detect pollutants, pesticides, toxic substances in soil, water, food and air

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is TLC called a qualitative rather than a quantitative technique?
(TLC ko quantitative ki bajaye qualitative technique kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: TLC zyada tar yeh batati hai ke kaun se substances maujood hain; miqdaar ka sirf andaza deti hai. Is liye yeh durust aur precise quantitative technique nahi.

book_ref.quote: TLC is not accurate and precise quantitative technique.

blocks.prompt:
21 Why is the resolution of spots in TLC not always high and sharp?
(TLC mein spots ki resolution hamesha ziyada aur saaf kyun nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: TLC qareebi Rf values wale compounds ko saaf alag nahi kar sakti, is liye un ke spots aapas mein mil jate hain aur resolution hamesha saaf nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: Hence resolution of spots is not always high and sharp.

blocks.prompt:
22 Why are TLC results sometimes not reproducible?
(TLC ke nataij kabhi kabhi dobara wohi kyun nahi aate?)
blocks.explanation: TLC nami (humidity), temperature aur kaam ki jagah ki safai ke liye hassaas hai; in mein tabdeeli reproducibility (dobara wohi nateeja) kam kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: which reduces reproducibility

blocks.prompt:
23 Name the stationary phase and mobile phase used in gas chromatography.
(Gas chromatography mein istemal hone wale stationary aur mobile phase ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase: silica (SiO₂) ya alumina (Al₂O₃) ke chhote zarron par juda non-volatile, long-chain, non-polar hydrocarbon liquid jis ka boiling point ziyada hai. Mobile phase: helium ya nitrogen jaisi inert carrier gas.

book_ref.quote: In GC, the mobile phase is an inert gas (carrier gas) such as helium or nitrogen.

blocks.prompt:
24 How does separation of components take place in the column of a gas chromatograph?
(Gas chromatograph ke column mein components ki separation kaise hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo substances stationary phase ke non-polar liquid se ziyada interact karte hain (maslan non-polar substances) woh column mein ahista chalte hain aur baaqi tez. Raftaar ka yeh farq unhein alag kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, substances that interact more strongly move slower while other move faster, resulting in separation.

blocks.prompt:
25 What is the role of the detector in GC?
(GC mein detector ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Column se nikalte alag shuda substances ko detector pehchan kar chromatogram naam ke graph par peaks ki shakal mein record karta hai. Yeh har component ka retention time bhi record karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Detector also records retention time of each component.

blocks.prompt:
26 How is GC used as a quantitative technique?
(GC ko quantitative technique ke tor par kaise istemal kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle peaks pehchani jati hain, phir har peak ka area naapa jata hai (area = ½ × base × height, kyun ke peaks triangle jaisi hain). Kisi peak ka area tamam peaks ke kul area ki percentage us component ka hissa batata hai.

book_ref.quote: The peaks obtained are first identified and then area of each peak is measured

blocks.prompt:
27 A GC chromatogram of esters A, B and C gives peak areas 2.4, 3.0 and 6.0 cm². Calculate the percentage of ester C.
(Esters A, B aur C ke GC chromatogram mein peak areas 2.4, 3.0 aur 6.0 cm² hain. Ester C ki percentage nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The percentage of an ester A in the mixture of three esters A, B and C is given by,

blocks.prompt:
28 When is peak height used instead of peak area in GC? Give a short example.
(GC mein peak area ki bajaye peak height kab istemal hoti hai? Mukhtasar misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab peaks bohat tang hon ya un ki base width milti julti ho. Misaal: heights 15, 25 aur 60 mm se teen components 15%, 25% aur 60% bante hain (15/100 × 100 = 15%).

book_ref.quote: If the peaks are very narrow or have similar base widths then peak height is used instead of area

blocks.prompt:
29 Give two uses of GC in sports.
(Khel mein GC ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) GC khiladiyon mein steroids ki maujoodgi check karti hai. (2) Car racing ke fuel ke components test karti hai.

book_ref.quote: This is also used to test the components of fuel used in car racing.

blocks.prompt:
30 Give two industrial uses of gas chromatography.
(Gas chromatography ke do industrial istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Petrochemical plants GC se fuels ki composition (banawat) dekhte hain. (2) Yeh environmental samples mein organic pollutants ki bohat thori miqdaar ka pata lagati hai, jis se quality control aur mahol ki hifazat hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Petrochemical plants use it to analyse the composition of fuels

blocks.prompt:
31 How is GC useful in pharmaceutical research?
(Pharmaceutical research mein GC kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: GC naye banaye gaye drugs ki purity test karti hai taa ke mareez tak pohanchne se pehle dawai mein koi nuqsaan-deh bacha hua solvent ya impurity na rahe.

book_ref.quote: ensuring that no harmful residual solvents or impurities remain in the final medication

blocks.prompt:
32 How did gas chromatography help in the case of Nian Bin?
(Nian Bin ke case mein gas chromatography ne kaise madad ki?)
blocks.explanation: Nian Bin par 2005 mein do bachon ke khanay mein rat poison (fluoroacetate) mila kar qatl ka ilzaam tha. Khanay ka sample gas chromatography se test hua jis ne sabit kiya ke zeher nahi mila tha, aur woh 2013 mein riha hua.

book_ref.quote: The food sample was tested using gas chromatography, which proved no mixing of the poison.

blocks.prompt:
33 Why can GC not be used for every sample? Give two reasons other than volatility.
(GC har sample ke liye kyun istemal nahi ho sakti? Volatility ke ilawa do wajoohat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Samples ko thermally stable hona chahiye; garmi se toot jane wale compounds istemal nahi ho sakte. (2) Proteins aur polymers jaise bare biomolecules aasani se bukhaar nahi bante. Saath hi instrument aur maintenance ka kharcha ziyada hai.

book_ref.quote: Instruments and maintenance costs for GC are high.

(Paper chromatography aur thin layer chromatography mein farq batayein.)
